law_name: GENOVA ICT key project (records-management / GEVER standard solution)
description: As the Federal Chancellor's delegate (commissioning authority), Rossi oversaw the GENOVA key project, which introduced the standard records-management (GEVER) solution across the central federal administration.
significance: A major federal digitalisation programme replacing legacy records-management systems; central to Rossi's stated priority of advancing the administration's digital transformation.
